**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

Section 11 satisfies the preferred position on every material term of the TRANSITION rule:

| Element | Preferred | Document |
|---|---|---|
| Transition assistance | Up to 6 months at then-current rates | 11.1 — up to six months at expiring Order Form rates (better for us), incl. knowledge transfer, replacement-supplier cooperation, migration, continued service at existing scope/SLAs |
| Data return | Machine-readable within 30 days | 11.2 — 30 days, complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable, with metadata; no withholding over fee disputes |
| Deletion + certification | Delete and certify thereafter | 11.3 — secure deletion from active systems and backups after Customer confirms return, certified by an authorized officer |

Cross-checked § 10 per the planner hint: it contains no data-destruction trigger or fee-conditionality that undercuts § 11 — access ends only after the agreed transition period, and Customer Data rights expressly survive.
